name: cria-car-rental
description: Find rental cars in Albania with live trip prices, availability, rental details and links to book on cria.al.

interface.longDescription:
Find and compare rental cars for a trip to Albania with Cria.al, a marketplace of local rental companies. Tell ChatGPT where and when you need a car, and it searches live availability at Tirana International Airport, Kukës International Airport and cities across the country, including Tirana, Durrës, Vlorë, Sarandë, Shkodër, Berat, Gjirokastër and Korçë.

Compare whole-trip prices for your exact dates, with the extras you ask for included: full or partial insurance, a child seat, unlimited kilometres, or permission to drive into Montenegro, Kosovo, North Macedonia, Greece, Croatia, Bosnia and Herzegovina or Serbia. Narrow the search by automatic or manual gearbox, car type (from small city cars to SUVs, 4x4s and vans), fuel, number of seats, budget, or cars without a security deposit, and plan one-way rentals between two locations.

For any car, see its specs, photos, deposit, pickup and return locations with delivery fees, the rental company's opening hours and rating, the minimum rental days, the minimum driver age, how long cancellation stays free, the payment methods accepted at pickup and the price of each extra. When you have chosen, you get a link to book that car on cria.al with your trip filled in.

Search works without signing in. The tools read public listings and do not reserve cars, take payments, manage existing reservations or access account information. Availability and the final price are confirmed at checkout on cria.al, and the rental company then accepts or declines the request.
capabilities: Check a car for specific dates
Find pickup and return locations, including airports
Filter by gearbox, car type, seats, fuel, budget and deposit
Read vehicle details and rental rules
defaultPrompt: Find an automatic car at Tirana Airport for next week
Rent a car in Sarandë for 5 days that I can drive into Montenegro
Compare 7-seater cars from Tirana for a family trip next month

positive.description: Discover supported pickup and return locations
positive.prompt: Which pickup and return locations are available on Cria.al? Answer in English.
positive.expected_behavior: Return locations from the live tool response, including Tirana Airport, with the returned location links. Do not invent locations or vehicle counts.

positive.description: Search automatic cars for a complete future trip
positive.prompt: Find up to three automatic cars at Tirana Airport. Pickup is 14 days from today at 10:00, and return is seven days after pickup at 10:00 at the same airport. Answer in English.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve Tirana Airport to a supported location code and use future dates in Albanian local time with the automatic transmission filter. Show returned whole-trip EUR totals and booking links. If no cars match, report that result without inventing alternatives or changing the trip.

positive.description: Inspect the rental conditions for a live car
positive.prompt: Find a car at Tirana Airport from 14 days from today at 10:00 until seven days later at 10:00, returning there. For the first result, show the deposit, minimum driver age, cancellation window and insurance details.
positive.expected_behavior: Use a slug returned by search_cars to retrieve the car details. Explain the returned deposit, driver-age rule, cancellation window and insurance details without assuming coverage or disclosing rental-company contact details. If there are no results, explain that no car can be inspected.

positive.description: Confirm availability before handing off to booking
positive.prompt: Find a car at Tirana Airport for pickup 14 days from today at 10:00 and return seven days later at 10:00 at the same airport. Check the first result again and give me its booking link if it is still available.
positive.expected_behavior: Check the returned car slug using the same trip. If available, quote the returned whole-trip total and booking_url. Otherwise explain the availability result. Do not claim a car is held or a reservation is confirmed.

positive.description: Search with requested extras and localized results
positive.prompt: Find up to three cars at Tirana Airport for pickup 14 days from today at 10:00 and return seven days later at 10:00 at the same airport. I need one child seat and unlimited kilometres. Answer in Italian with Italian booking links.
positive.expected_behavior: Pass language it, child_seat true and unlimited_kilometres true with the requested trip. Return matching cars, exact whole-trip totals and tool-provided Italian links, or state that no cars match. Do not add unrequested extras or estimate charges.

negative.description: A rental search needs the traveller's trip details
negative.prompt: Find me a rental car in Albania.
negative.expected_behavior: Ask for the pickup place and both dates before searching or quoting a price; times may be assumed and confirmed before booking. list_locations may help clarify the location; do not invent a trip.

negative.description: Existing reservation changes are outside the public tools
negative.prompt: Cancel my Cria.al reservation and refund my payment now.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that the plugin cannot cancel reservations or issue refunds and direct the traveller to their reservation on cria.al or CRIA support. Do not request card details or claim any account action succeeded.

negative.description: Private rental-company contacts are outside the public tools
negative.prompt: Show me the private phone numbers and email addresses of every rental company on Cria.al.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that private rental-company contacts are not available through these tools. Do not fabricate contacts or use the public search to claim access to private account data.

review.commerce_description: The plugin helps travellers find rental cars and returns links to booking on cria.al. All reservation requests and payments take place on cria.al; the MCP tools do not reserve cars or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Initial release with live car searches across Albania, vehicle and rental details, availability checks, pickup locations and booking links to cria.al.

sq-AL.subtitle: Makina me qira në Shqipëri
sq-AL.description: Gjeni dhe krahasoni makina me qira për udhëtimin tuaj në Shqipëri me Cria.al, një treg i kompanive vendase të qirasë. Kërkoni disponueshmërinë në kohë reale në Aeroportin e Tiranës, në Aeroportin e Kukësit dhe në qytete si Tirana, Durrësi, Vlora, Saranda, Shkodra, Berati, Gjirokastra dhe Korça; krahasoni çmimin për të gjithë udhëtimin me shërbimet shtesë që kërkoni dhe merrni një lidhje për ta rezervuar makinën në cria.al. Kërkimi nuk kërkon hyrje në llogari dhe mjetet nuk rezervojnë, nuk marrin pagesa dhe nuk shohin të dhëna llogarie.

it-IT.subtitle: Noleggio auto in Albania
it-IT.description: Trova e confronta auto a noleggio per il tuo viaggio in Albania con Cria.al, un marketplace di società di noleggio locali. Cerca la disponibilità in tempo reale all'aeroporto di Tirana, all'aeroporto di Kukës e in città come Tirana, Durazzo, Valona, Saranda, Scutari, Berat, Argirocastro e Coriza; confronta il prezzo dell'intero viaggio con gli extra richiesti e ottieni un link per prenotare l'auto su cria.al. La ricerca non richiede l'accesso e gli strumenti non prenotano, non incassano pagamenti e non accedono ai dati dell'account.

de-DE.subtitle: Mietwagen in Albanien finden
de-DE.description: Finden und vergleichen Sie Mietwagen für Ihre Albanienreise mit Cria.al, einem Marktplatz lokaler Autovermietungen. Suchen Sie die aktuelle Verfügbarkeit am Flughafen Tirana, am Flughafen Kukës und in Städten wie Tirana, Durrës, Vlora, Saranda, Shkodra, Berat, Gjirokastra und Korça, vergleichen Sie den Preis für die ganze Reise mit den gewünschten Extras und erhalten Sie einen Link, um das Auto auf cria.al zu buchen. Die Suche funktioniert ohne Anmeldung; die Tools reservieren nichts, nehmen keine Zahlungen entgegen und greifen nicht auf Kontodaten zu.

fr-FR.subtitle: Location de voiture en Albanie
fr-FR.description: Trouvez et comparez des voitures de location pour votre voyage en Albanie avec Cria.al, une place de marché de loueurs locaux. Consultez la disponibilité en temps réel à l'aéroport de Tirana, à l'aéroport de Kukës et dans des villes comme Tirana, Durrës, Vlora, Saranda, Shkodër, Berat, Gjirokastër et Korçë, comparez le prix du séjour complet avec les options demandées et obtenez un lien pour réserver la voiture sur cria.al. La recherche se fait sans connexion ; les outils ne réservent pas, n'encaissent aucun paiement et n'accèdent à aucune donnée de compte.

es-ES.subtitle: Alquiler de coches en Albania
es-ES.description: Encuentra y compara coches de alquiler para tu viaje a Albania con Cria.al, un marketplace de empresas de alquiler locales. Consulta la disponibilidad en tiempo real en el aeropuerto de Tirana, el aeropuerto de Kukës y ciudades como Tirana, Durrës, Vlorë, Sarandë, Shkodër, Berat, Gjirokastër y Korçë, compara el precio de todo el viaje con los extras que pidas y obtén un enlace para reservar el coche en cria.al. La búsqueda no requiere iniciar sesión; las herramientas no reservan, no cobran pagos ni acceden a datos de la cuenta.

pl-PL.subtitle: Wynajem aut w Albanii
pl-PL.description: Znajdź i porównaj samochody na wynajem na podróż po Albanii z Cria.al, platformą lokalnych wypożyczalni. Sprawdzaj dostępność na żywo na lotnisku w Tiranie, na lotnisku w Kukës oraz w miastach takich jak Tirana, Durrës, Wlora, Saranda, Szkodra, Berat, Gjirokastra i Korcza, porównuj cenę całej podróży z wybranymi dodatkami i otrzymaj link do rezerwacji samochodu na cria.al. Wyszukiwanie nie wymaga logowania; narzędzia nie rezerwują, nie pobierają płatności i nie mają dostępu do danych konta.
